payload.blocks: Only the design check of phase 1; phases 1 and 2 implement now on the exec-wrap design. Phase 4 (live check) needs it before the plan can close.
payload.headline: Run the 20-second scope-wrap proof of plan 261127-0016 in an unconfined shell? No confined session reaches the user bus

parts.cause: My shell and every unit sandbox fail `systemd-run --user` with 'Failed to connect to user scope bus: No data available' (runtimeDir mask), so no confined session can run it.

options.does: Owner or lead:SUPERVISOR runs the block in an unconfined shell and answers with the RESULT line
options.gain: Settles the design in 20 seconds; phase 1 lands on proof
options.label: You paste the script once

options.does: Land phase 1 on the exec-wrap design untested; the phase-4 live run (also unconfined) proves it
options.harm: A failure is found later and needs a fix unit for the fallback
options.label: Defer to phase 4 live check

parts.recommendation: Paste the script once: it is the risk the plan names first, and a fail switches phase 1 to the fallback before phase 3 builds on it.

scope.allows: Running the script and reporting its output; I fill the Result section
scope.forbids: Any change to the plan footprint or the design decisions D1-D4

parts.what: Phase 1 must first prove that a lock held as fd 3 survives `setsid systemd-run --user --scope ... -- <cmd>`. The script is in plans/261127-0016-head-run-own-failure-domain/reports/scope-wrap-proof.md (landed 71ba28c05).
